name: Saimin Kyoushitsu
source:
Yoshiki spends his days as commonplace, everyday student.

But one day, his teacher, Miss Ando Noriko, changes his life forever through a hypnotism experiment.

Through the abilities granted to him is by the hypnotist, he gathers popularity as both an excellent student and athlete at his new school.

It is also there where he spends his days as the sex slave of the lustful Noriko both on and off campus!

However, the relationship between Yoshiki and Noriko becomes clear to the student council head Tsukata Miki, and to Ueno Masae and Tanimoto Ayumu, who witness the two in action!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041806.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
芳树原本只是一名日复一日过着平淡生活的普通男学生。

然而某一天，女教师安藤典子的一场催眠实验，彻底改写了他的人生轨迹。

借助催眠术赋予的潜能，芳树在转入的新学校里一跃成为品学兼优、运动全能的风云人物；

与此同时，无论在校内还是校外，他都日夜充当着欲求不满的典子老师的专属肉奴隶！

然而好景不长，芳树与典子老师颠鸾倒凤的场面，竟被学生会长冢田美纪，以及上野雅惠、谷本步三人当场撞破，这段不可告人的禁忌关系彻底败露！
